closure_reference_normalization.control_event_rule: Exact CE-* literal only; placeholders/wildcards such as CE-RT-… are not concrete IDs.
closure_reference_normalization.dependency_law_rule: Exact stable law ID only; no heading/marker inference.
closure_reference_normalization.floor_alias_rule: Resolve AIR-FLOOR-NNN short alias only when exactly one canonical full ID with that numeric prefix exists.
closure_reference_normalization.runtime_dependency_rule: Exact DEP.* ID must exist in Final Core route/dependency kernel.
closure_reference_normalization.runtime_route_rule: Exact RT.* ID must exist in R13 route map.

router_resolution_invariants: Missing or unresolved task-class metadata does not default to include or exclude.
Missing or unresolved AMRS metadata does not default to global applicability.
Mandatory floor closure is additive after task-class/AMRS selection and cannot remove a selected mandatory floor.
Law dependency expansion uses exact stable law IDs only and rejects cycles or unknown IDs.
Runtime dependency expansion uses exact DEP.* identities only.
Applicability evidence must explain include/exclude/unresolved for every registry law considered.
Router output has no semantic-definition, approval, or positive execution authority.

task_target_amrs_predicate_schema.generic_higher_amrs_language_rule: Descriptive burden language alone does not create MIN_STAGE or STAGE_SET.
task_target_amrs_predicate_schema.internal_field_condition_rule: An AMRS-conditioned field requirement does not automatically become a law-level applicability predicate.

predicate_types.EXACT_STAGE: Applies only to one explicitly named AMRS stage.
predicate_types.EXPLICITLY_AMRS_INDEPENDENT: Allowed only when source explicitly states independence from AMRS target.
predicate_types.MATURITY_BEARING: Applies when the source explicitly conditions behavior on maturity/readiness being material or AMRS stage completion/promotion.
predicate_types.MIN_STAGE: Applies at or above an explicitly named minimum AMRS stage.
predicate_types.STAGE_SET: Applies only to an explicit finite set of named AMRS stages.
predicate_types.UNRESOLVED: No operative AMRS predicate; fail closed for AMRS-sensitive resolution.
